subject: Discovery follow-up: propose rotating demo cadence to cover US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@monarchhealth.com>, Oliver Brandt <oliver@medtech-eu.com>, Jin Park <jin.park@zenmetrics.co.jp>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Discovery follow-up: propose rotating demo cadence to cover US/EU/APAC

Hi Priya / Oliver / Jin —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and helpful context on Monarch’s ingestion patterns and multi-region support needs. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to make scheduling the next technical deep dive easier for all time zones.

Recap (high level)
- Primary workload: patient analytics pipelines, bursty nightly runs and on-demand inference for dashboards
- Key constraints: data residency for EU, low-latency portal queries for US & APAC customers, and SOC2 evidence requirements
- Success criteria for next meeting: confirm architecture assumptions, validate latency targets on a sample request, and review integration touchpoints (auth, KMS, audit logs)

Scheduling challenge
- We heard that getting the right people together across US / EU / APAC is the biggest blocker. To avoid repeated re-scheduling, I’d like to propose a short rotating demo pilot where the dedicated technical deep dive moves between time windows so the same edge stakeholders can attend at least one slot within a three-week cycle.

Proposed rotation (three-week pilot)
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 09:00–10:00 ET — focuses on dashboard latency, caching
- Week B (EU-friendly): Thu 15:00–16:00 CET — focuses on data residency and audit flows
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Fri 10:00–11:00 JST — focuses on throughput and connection stability

What I need from you
1) Pick the slot (A / B / C) you prefer for the first session (we’ll run the pilot across three consecutive weeks)
2) Confirm the attendees for the technical deep dive (engineers, infra owners, security reviewer) — I saw an internal infra contact on your notes but please confirm
3) Any must-cover agenda items we should add (e.g., KMS provider, VPC peering, model quantization thresholds)

I’ve attached a short one-pager with discovery notes and a tentative rotating calendar (.ics). If that works I’ll have Karthik lead the technical deep dive and Marcus will prepare a latency/throughput checklist.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, rotating-cadence.ics

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a provisional calendar based on your picks.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes

- Our core attendees for the deep dive: Priya Shah (myself), Samir Patel (Lead Engineer), and Claire Huang (Security). I’m looping Samir on this thread so he can confirm the technical checklist.

Samir — are you able to attend Tue 09:00–10:00 ET next week as the first slot? If not, we can flip to the EU slot.

Looping in a slightly more prescriptive proposal so booking is faster. I’ve created a three-week rotation table and attached an .ics bundle with tentative invites — you can accept just the sessions you want.

Rotation proposal (concrete)
- Week 1 (US slot) — Tue 09:00–10:00 ET — agenda: latency demo (live), cache warmup pattern, integration checklist
- Week 2 (EU slot) — Thu 15:00–16:00 CET — agenda: data residency, audit log flows, compliance Q&A
- Week 3 (APAC slot) — Fri 10:00–11:00 JST — agenda: throughput stresscases, region-to-region failover

Operational notes:
- Each session will be 45 minutes + 15 minutes for Q&A so it stays tight
- We’ll record and surface the recording plus the MAP-heatmap.xlsx post-call for follow-up
- If you prefer a different cadence (e.g., alternate-week rotation) say so — the pilot is flexible

I’ve scheduled placeholder invites and shared a Calendly link here: https://calendly.com/redwood/rotating-demo-pilot

— Monica
